rationale:
The requirement has one obligation. The review prompt must give a report template with four sections: revised text of every group requirement (complete directives, including new splits), revised text of outside requirements the changes affect, mechanical changes (new full names and added examples), and design questions.

`tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[the_review_prompt_gives_a_report_template]` is marked `{test}` for this requirement. It extracts the `## Report` section of the review prompt with `section(review_prompt(), "## Report")`. `section` collapses whitespace and counts fenced lines as part of the body, so the template inside the ```text fence is searched. It then calls `assert_text_in_order`, which requires each phrase to appear after the previous one. The phrases are:
- `### Revised text`, then "as complete directives ready to paste, including new split requirements". This covers the group-revision section, including the complete-directive and split-requirement clauses.
- `### Edits outside the group`, then "revised text of other requirements your changes make stale". This covers outside requirements the changes affect.
- `### Mechanical changes`, then "list new full names and added examples". This covers the mechanical-changes section, including new names and examples.
- `### Design questions`. This covers the fourth section.

The actual `## Report` template in `assets/skills/habeas-requirements/references/review-prompt.md` contains these phrases in this order. A prompt missing any section, its heading, or its key content would make the test fail.

Gaps considered:
- The test does not assert the words "every requirement in the group". The "complete directives ready to paste, including new split requirements" phrase still checks the substance of that bullet, and I don't treat the omission as a gap.
- I found no other mode or boundary case in the requirement that needs a separate test.

A neighbouring test, `the_review_prompt_rejects_a_report_with_only_wording_changes`, covers a different requirement (`no_questions`) and is not needed here.

text: The review prompt MUST give a report template with these sections:
- the revised text of every requirement in the group, including new split requirements, as complete directives ready to paste;
- the revised text of requirements outside the group that the changes affect;
- the mechanical changes, including new full names and added examples;
